acceptance.engineering: finite gradients; actor independent of future labels; causal history; frozen EMA teacher; resume continuity and failed save preservation
acceptance.fit_probe: report before/after true noise-to-trajectory sampling on train including stop/deceleration; do not equate falling bridge loss to successful driving
acceptance.next_stage_only_if: relative to temporal_flow on both seeds: deceleration meanADE improves >=10%, overall meanADE regresses <=5%, stationary forward bias does not increase; noncollapse probes pass
acceptance.closed_loop: not enabled by this fit probe; requires matched scenarios/controller, held-out scene seeds, collisions/lane departures/completion/progress/comfort/takeovers/latency and separate sim/wall clocks

limitations: Diagnostic enriched 64+64 window subsets, overlapping supports, low speeds, source OCC causality not fully certified. Same updates is not same FLOPs. Formal full split multi-seed experiment remains gated.
